server.title: Jithox BE Commerce Preflight

io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.accessModel: OAuth 2.1 with mandatory PKCE (S256). Alternatively (JX-MCP-079C) the same access key works directly per call for clients whose OAuth callback is blocked: Authorization: Bearer <access key> or X-Jithox-Api-Key — never both. Treat a key in client config like a password; rotate/revoke at jithox.com.
boundaries: This server never places, modifies or cancels an order and never touches a payment, card or checkout.
A no-match is 'no_match_in_queried_source', never 'not sold in Belgium'.
Comparisons are value tables on a stated criterion — never a ranking sold as advice.
Prices and availability are the queried source's declarations at the stated time, never a guarantee they still hold.
No independent penetration test has been performed.
io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.commercialStatus: NOT_OFFERED — endpoint public and live, sale withheld until a retail source is connected. Never read as adoption.
io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.pricing: Not offered for sale yet. A candidate price is recorded and activates nothing.
io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.remoteDeployment: Single public HTTPS endpoint operated by Jithox.

toolDescriptions.build_affiliate_buy_link: Deterministically build the official product link with partner tracking, for a HUMAN to click. Nothing is ordered.
toolDescriptions.compare_product_offers: Compare 2-5 EANs as a value table ordered by a stated criterion. A table, never advice.
toolDescriptions.get_commerce_readiness: Whether a retail source and the affiliate programme are configured on this deployment.
toolDescriptions.get_product_offer: One product's current offer: price in integer cents, availability, seller count, delivery promise, each with source and retrieval time.
toolDescriptions.search_retail_products: Search Belgian retail products by free text or EAN against the queried source; deterministic match kinds, visible ambiguity.

io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.toolStatus: LIVE_BUT_SOURCE_NOT_CONNECTED — every source-backed tool returns a truthful not_configured that costs nothing until a retail partner source is connected.

headers.description: OAuth 2.1 bearer. Discover the authorization server via /.well-known/oauth-protected-resource; PKCE S256 is mandatory; tokens are audience-bound to https://energy.mcp.jithox.com/mcp with least-privilege per-tool scopes. A token issued for the Jithox E-Invoice, Import Preflight or Sanctions Preflight server is rejected here (separate resource/audience).
headers.name: Authorization

io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.accessModel: Controlled paid pilot: invite-only (operator-registered OAuth client + access key), OAuth 2.1 + PKCE, per-workspace prepaid EUR credit. EUR 0.25 per accepted chargeable call; every non-answer costs EUR 0.00.
io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.commercialStatus: SELLABLE_CONTROLLED_PILOT — invite-only paid pilot; prepaid EUR workspace credit; signed receipts on the product's own key. 0 paying Energy Label Preflight developers at publication; no revenue claim.
io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.eprelSourceGate: The official EPREL Public API requires a Commission-issued API key; the owner holds one and the source acceptance gate is PASS. The key stays server-side (file secret). A no-match is never 'not registered', and an outage is never a verdict.
io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.officialSourceIntent: Source: EPREL (European Product Registry for Energy Labelling), European Commission — supplier-declared data, verified live (JX-124). Per the accepted API terms: value-added use only (raw data never resold as a standalone product), mandatory EU/EPREL attribution, no implied EU endorsement, and locally-stored data must reflect updates/corrections/deletions (live API + bounded short-TTL cache; no long-lived snapshot).
io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.pricing: EUR 0.25 per accepted chargeable call — controlled invite-only pilot; approved workspaces; prepaid EUR workspace credit; failed, refused, rate-limited and source-unavailable calls cost EUR 0.00.
io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.publicationStatus: CONTROLLED PAID PILOT — first publication to the official MCP Registry (owner-approved three-product commercial go-live, JX-177). Invite-only evaluation and paid pilot access.
io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.remoteDeployment: Live at https://energy.mcp.jithox.com/mcp behind Caddy TLS; EPREL official API adapter active with the Commission-issued key held server-side. Immutable image digest recorded in the fleet repository's deployment evidence at each release.

toolDescriptions.compare_eprel_product_metrics: Value table over COMMON declared metrics of compatible records; cross-group fails safely; no ranking.
toolDescriptions.get_eprel_energy_label_data: Declared label/product-sheet data marked supplierDeclared=true, independentlyVerifiedByJithox=false.
toolDescriptions.get_eprel_product_record: Structure one public record's supplier-declared fields; missing fields listed, never invented.
toolDescriptions.prepare_energy_label_preflight_receipt: Idempotent Ed25519 receipt over fingerprinted inputs/sources/decision states — attests the lookups, never an outcome.
toolDescriptions.search_eprel_products: Search candidate public records by model identifier, registration number or brand+group; ambiguity shown, never resolved by guessing.

io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.toolStatus: live_proven — deployed at https://energy.mcp.jithox.com/mcp (serverInfo.version 0.1.0); five-tool money-lane E2E proven live (capture 25 on accepted answers incl. exact_public_record/no_match; needs-more-input and source refusals cost EUR 0.00; restart persistence; rate limits; kill switch; credential rotation incl. authorization retirement).
